title: This AI can read your mind and it's terrifying

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This AI can read your mind through neural pattern recognition — it’s not surveillance, it’s evolution. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You’re misrepresenting intent. Mind-reading tech is still in infancy, and current protocols lack ethical safeguards. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Neural mapping is already used in BCIs like Neuralink — this is about enhancing human potential, not control. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even if safe now, the risk of misuse is too high. No AI should have that level of access without strict oversight. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Privacy is non-negotiable — this tech crosses a line no society should accept. (4 sec)
